robolectric-testing/com.google.maps.android.robolectric.truth/GoogleMapSubject

GoogleMapSubject

class GoogleMapSubject : Subject

Comprehensive Google Truth Subject for asserting on a GoogleMap instance.

Designed for maximum succinctness: a single assertThat(map) chain can verify camera coordinates, zoom levels, marker presence/metadata, active info windows, shape overlays, and rendered canvas pixel colors.
